rows.note: Use 肥 as the all-purpose everyday description of a fat or obese person or animal.

example.english: That dog is so blubbery that it pants after walking two steps.
example.traditional: 嗰隻狗肥到行兩步都喘氣。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 fei4 dou3 haang4 loeng5 bou6 dou1 cyun2 hei3

rows.note: Use this technical description for a material or texture that resembles blubber or fat.

example.english: The texture of this cream becomes blubbery after heating.
example.traditional: 呢種乳霜加熱之後會變成脂肪狀。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 jyu5 soeng1 gaa1 jit6 zi1 hau6 wui5 bin3 sing4 zi1 fong1 zong6
